description: This file defines a Java class 'CyclicBuffer', which implements a fixed-size, cyclic buffer for storing double values. It provides methods for adding values, clearing the buffer, and retrieving stored values and size information.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A fixed-size, cyclic buffer for storing double values that implements the DataBuffer interface.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a maximum size.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the buffer, resetting size and pointer.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new double value to the buffer, overwriting oldest values if full.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the current number of stored values.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns a copy of the stored values as an array.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific index in the buffer.
